practiceReport.beatComment: Johnson injured his ankle while on kickoff coverage early in the first quarter. He was carted off the field, and medical staff have determined that the injury is severe enough for Johnson to be sidelined for the rest of Sunday's contest. Salvon Ahmed will move into the RB3 role behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai in Johnson's absence.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (12th NFL season, 70% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: After missing the Bears' walk-through practice Wednesday, Jarrett logged a limited practice Thursday and then upgraded again to a full practice Friday. He should start on the interior of the defensive line next to Jeffery Simmons again in Week 9.

practiceReport.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Stevenson injured his hand during the Bears' Week 9 win over the Buccaneers. He had additional time to rest thanks to the Week 10 bye, and given Stevenson's absence from Wednesday's estimated practice report, the fourth-year defensive back should suit up Sunday against the Saints. He has accumulated 34 tackles (23 solo) and four pass defenses through eight regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Zavion Thomas
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Thomas popped up on the practice report as a nonparticipant Friday due to an ankle issue and was initially deemed questionable for Sunday. However, the rookie will ultimately be able to play through the issue. Thomas typically has a minimal role on offense, as he's caught more than one pass in only one of his nine appearances so far. However, he's worked as Chicago's primary kickoff returner and should again contribute in that role against the Saints.
